To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present MLCapsule: Guarded offline deployment of MLaaS.
We propose MLCapsules for guarded deployment of machine learning models, and demonstrate their security, efficiency, and applicability to a range of use cases.

MLCapsule provides a guarded offline deployment that is secure against model extraction and membership inference attacks, and is applicable to offline scenarios such as medical diagnosis and autonomous driving.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question: how to securely and efficiently execute machine learning as a black-box service on a user’s device.
the question: Can a user securely query an ML model offline without sending the user’s data to a server or sharing the model with the user?

the following research questions: (1) Can we securely deploy ML as a service in a way that the model is executed offline on the user’s device? (2) Can we protect the service provider’s model against model stealing, reverse-engineering, and membership inference attacks?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
MLCapsule can protect the user’s privacy and service provider’s intellectual property, while providing a secure and reliable machine learning service.
MLCapsule enables a new level of security and privacy in machine learning as a cloud service.
MLCapsule provides the best possible protection of the ML model and data privacy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we provide the service provider a way to deploy its model securely, locally, and offline while protecting the privacy of the users.
we present an efficient solution for guarded offline deployment of ML models.
we present the first secure and guarded deployment of ML as a service.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the security guarantees provided to the service provider can be achieved without compromising user privacy.
the secure offline deployment is a viable alternative to the server-side execution of machine learning models.
the secure execution of machine learning models is possible even in an offline setting, without requiring the user to trust the server.
